## Activity

During October 2021, Market Eye Clinic completed 333 captures. This records the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance. The volume of completed captures should be considered alongside the results below when monitoring routine service delivery and identifying any operational issues requiring follow-up.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 17 were marked ungradable. The ungradable_rate was 5.1. These results should continue to be reviewed as part of the site’s routine quality monitoring. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that potential equipment or process problems can be followed up through the usual support arrangements.

## Grading

Grading identified 84 referable results. The median lag from photograph to grade was 4 days. This provides a summary measure of the time taken for images to progress through grading during October 2021. The site should continue to monitor grading activity and image quality together, ensuring that ungradable captures and referable results remain visible in routine operational review.
